review.tagline: Next.js demo app for trying OpenAI text-to-speech models
review.summary: OpenAI.fm is the source for the openai.fm demo, a web interface for generating speech through the OpenAI Speech API. It is a Next.js app that needs an OpenAI API key; an optional Postgres database enables a sharing feature. It is a demo reference rather than a general-purpose starter.
review.audience: Developers learning to build on the OpenAI Speech API
strengths: Official OpenAI reference for calling the Speech API from Next.js
Runs with only an API key; no database needed for core use
weaknesses: Tied to the OpenAI API; no other TTS providers
No Dockerfile or compose file in the README
Sharing feature requires a hosted Postgres database
Maintainers say they may not review all issues or PRs
needs: Needs OpenAI API, Postgres (optional, sharing only)
